input.title: Ignore RUSTSEC-2026-0459 (libsqlite3-sys 0.37) until sqlx allows libsqlite3-sys >= 0.39
input.description:
## What happened

On 2026-11-12, the `audit` and `deny` gates on `main` failed. The cause is a new advisory, RUSTSEC-2026-0459. It flags `libsqlite3-sys` 0.37.0, which bundles C SQLite with CVE-2026-119375 (severity 6.8, medium). The fix is `libsqlite3-sys` 0.39.0 or later.

The failure is not from a code change. PR #331 (async-openai bump) was the first push to `main` after the advisory was published.

## Why a lockfile update cannot fix it

`sqlx-sqlite` 0.9.0 requires `libsqlite3-sys = ">=0.30.1, <0.38.0"`. `sqlx` 0.9.0 is the latest release. Thus no compatible fixed version exists.

Path: `libsqlite3-sys` → `sqlx-sqlite` → `sqlx` → `paigasus-helikon-evals`, `paigasus-helikon-sessions-sqlite`, `paigasus-helikon-sessions-postgres`.

## Decision

Sven decided on 2026-11-12: add RUSTSEC-2026-0459 to the ignore lists in `.cargo/audit.toml` and `deny.toml`. This unblocks all PRs. This ticket tracks the removal of the ignore.

## To do

- [x] Add the ignore to `.cargo/audit.toml` and `deny.toml`.
- [ ] When a `sqlx` release allows `libsqlite3-sys` >= 0.39, bump `sqlx` and remove both ignore entries.
- [ ] Make sure that `cargo audit --deny warnings` and `cargo deny check advisories` pass without the ignore.

## Note

The vulnerable SQLite code ships in the published crates that use `sqlx` with SQLite. Users who need the fix before the `sqlx` release can use the `sqlx` unbundled SQLite feature with a fixed system SQLite.

input.description:
## What happened

On 2026-11-12, `clippy` failed on the release-plz release PR (PR 333). Its `cargo update` pulled a newer `aws-config`, which deprecates `BehaviorVersion::v2026_01_12` with the note: "Superseded by v2026_11_10, which updates retry behavior per the Retry Behavior 2.1 spec." With `-D warnings`, the deprecation fails `crates/paigasus-helikon-providers-bedrock/src/builder.rs:258`.

`main` does not fail yet, because its lockfile still has `aws-config` 1.13.0.

## Decision

Sven decided on 2026-11-12: use `BehaviorVersion::v2026_11_10()` (not `#[allow(deprecated)]`).

## Effect on users

The default retry behavior of the Bedrock provider changes to the AWS Retry Behavior 2.1 spec. The commit message carries a note, so that the release-plz CHANGELOG shows it.

## To do

- [ ] Change the behavior version in `builder.rs`.
- [ ] Raise the `aws-config` minimum in `[workspace.dependencies]` to the first release that has `v2026_11_10`, and update `Cargo.lock`.
- [ ] Update docs that name the old behavior version, if any.

content.text:
I opened PR #335 for the first fix, and its CI is running.

**What the PR changes:**
- **Production code:** `BedrockModel::from_env` now uses `BehaviorVersion::v2026_11_10()`. The doc comment now says that this version applies the AWS Retry Behavior 2.1 spec.
- **Tests:** The tests in `builder.rs`, `model.rs` and `translate/mod.rs` use the new version.
- **Minimum version:** In `Cargo.toml`, the minimum for `aws-smithy-runtime-api` is now `1.21.0`. That is the first release with `v2026_11_10`. `aws_config::BehaviorVersion` is a re-export from that crate. Without the higher minimum, the published crate could resolve an older version that does not have the function.
- **Lockfile:** `Cargo.lock` changes only two crates: `aws-smithy-runtime-api` 1.20.0 → 1.21.0 and `aws-smithy-types` 1.9.3 → 1.9.4. `cargo update` also re-picked `windows-sys` versions for about 11 crates that this fix does not use. I removed those changes. `cargo metadata --locked` accepts the file.
- **Docs:** The crate README and the mdBook page `concepts/model-providers.md` use the new version in their examples.
- **CHANGELOG:** The commit message says that the retry behavior changes, so the release-plz CHANGELOG will show it.

**Checks:**
- Local: fmt, clippy (`-D warnings`, all features, all targets) and the docs build pass.
- I did not run the Bedrock tests locally. My notes say they give false failures in this checkout path on macOS, so CI runs them.

**Other notes:**
- The ticket is SMA-766.
- The commit-msg hook rejected the scope `providers-bedrock`, so the commit and the PR title use `providers`.
- SMA-763 is back in Backlog.

When CI is green, you must merge #335 yourself, because your account is its author:

```
! gh pr merge 335 --squash --admin --delete-branch
```

After that merge, release-plz updates PR #333. Then I will check that its CI is green.
